hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do if [ -x "$d/venv/bin/ruff" ]; then "$d/venv/bin/ruff" format "$f"; exit 0; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff format "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
